name: Wichita (United States)
description: Three white and three red rays sweep from the hoist, bearing a blue disc charged with a white Native American hogan symbol.
history: Designed by Cecil McAlister and adopted in 1937, Wichita's flag is regularly ranked among the best US city flags; the rays represent paths to home, the hogan symbol permanent home.

features.role: field of alternating red and white rays
hogan symbol — an open circle with three dots
features.symbolism: a Native American symbol of home and freedom to come and go
